name: account_number
description: Bank account number the transaction was posted against.

name: transaction_type
description: Whether the transaction was a Credit or a Debit.

name: balance_after_transaction
description: Account balance immediately after this transaction was applied.

name: merchant_category
description: Category of the merchant/transaction, e.g. Groceries, Salary, Fuel, Transfer.

name: branch_code
description: Code of the bank branch that processed the transaction.

name: payment_mode
description: Channel used: UPI / NEFT / IMPS / Card / Cash / Cheque.
